FF reports 265 robotics-device sales and shipments in September

The company reports 817 cumulative units and plans an October 14 education-product event; the totals cover multiple device forms.

FF EAI Robotics ↗5 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1Videos 1

Company-reported monthly totals

An October 5 investor release reports 265 robotics-device sales and shipments in September, 575 during Q3 and 817 from late February through September. The release combines sales and shipments in its wording. These are company-reported figures across device forms, not a count exclusively of humanoids or independently audited totals in this article.

Applications are at different stages

FF describes education and research as entering early scaled growth, security and inspection as initial proof-of-concept deployments, and industrial and logistics work as channel expansion and internal development. Commercial services are still validating operating revenue. Those stages matter: aggregate device totals do not establish mature deployment in every application.

An event and a proposed transaction

FFAI and FFR plan an October 14 Pacific Time event for education-related EAI Brain, Skills and device products, including the Physical AI Spark Program. The transfer of the robotics business to FFR remains a proposed transaction subject to completion. Planned products and restructuring should be distinguished from reported activity; the company’s market-ranking claims are not independently verified here.
